statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-50525 (GHSA-8q5v-6pqq-x66h) is a .NET denial of service issue in XML encryption (EncryptedXml in System.Security.Cryptography.Xml): crafted encrypted XML can cause uncontrolled resource consumption. Microsoft lists the System.Security.Cryptography.Xml package as affected from 10.0.0 through 10.0.9 and fixed in 10.0.10 shipped with .NET 10.0.10 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8q5v-6pqq-x66h, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.10/10.0.10.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold. Implementation copies of System.Security.Cryptography.Xml.dll are in the Microsoft.AspNetCore.App shared framework (aspnetcore10-runtime, and the .NET SDK and the ASP.NET Core runtime archive held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap), the SDK's own and F# copies and the ASP.NET Core runtime pack in dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap, and, in dotnet10-runtime-artifacts, the System.Security.Cryptography.Xml nupkg, the ASP.NET Core and WindowsDesktop transport nupkg files and the Arcade SDK and Build.Tasks.Feed build-tool nupkg files. Each copy carries the build's own .NET file version, except the build-tool copies, which can carry an earlier 10.0 servicing version (for example 10.0.10 alongside 10.0.13 in the aarch64 10.0.13-r0 build). The System.Security.Cryptography.Xml nupkg version equals the build version. The first eight builds (10.0.2-r0 to 10.0.9-r0) hold unfixed copies; from 10.0.10-r0 on every implementation copy is 10.0.10 or later. The remaining copies are reference assemblies with no implementation code. The range ends at 10.0.10-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
